meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 当你要求重构代码时,Claude 会先确认目标和范围,分析代码结构、依赖和测试覆盖,制定计划后再一步步修改,每步都运行测试验证,最后汇总改动和影响。
howto.when: 当你提到 refactor、cleanup、restructure 等关键词,或要求抽取、简化、现代化代码时触发。

say.note: 会先分析再逐步修改并验证

say.text: 把 AuthService 类里的验证逻辑抽取到独立模块
say.note: 按抽取目标执行重构流程

say.text: 用安全策略重构整个项目,范围设为 project
say.note: 走完整分析、计划与验证流程

howto.what_en: When you ask for a code refactor, Claude first confirms goals and scope, analyzes code structure, dependencies and test coverage, then plans and executes changes step-by-step, running tests after each step, and finally summarizes the changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say refactor, cleanup, restructure, or ask to extract, simplify, modernize code.

say_en.note: Claude will analyze, modify, and verify step by step.

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic in AuthService into a separate module.
say_en.note: It will follow the extraction workflow.

say_en.text: Refactor the whole project with safe strategy and scope project.
